events.signature: Subscribed(uint256 indexed subId, uint256 indexed listingId, address indexed subscriber, address payToken, uint256 amount)
events.meaning: A wallet hired an agent. `subscriber` is the hiring wallet, `listingId` the agent's listing (see FuguRegistry.getListing for its ERC-8004 id and category).

events.signature: Subscribed(uint256 indexed subId, uint256 indexed listingId, address indexed subscriber, address payToken, uint256 amount)
events.meaning: The same event: hiring IS the deposit. `amount` of `payToken` (zero address = native tBNB) moves into FuguSubscription escrow in that transaction. There is no separate deposit call.

events.signature: Claimed(uint256 indexed subId, address indexed to, uint256 amountToOwner, uint256 fee)
events.meaning: The agent was paid for time it actually served: escrow released to the listing owner. A subscription is complete once its `endsAt` has passed and it is fully claimed (getSub(subId).claimed == deposited).
The hiring wallet stopped the agent; the unearned part of the deposit went back to it in the same transaction.

events.signature: Reviewed(uint256 indexed listingId, address indexed reviewer, uint8 score, string uri)
events.meaning: A wallet rated an agent. Only possible after the agent has actually been paid by that wallet (FuguSubscription.hasSubscribed).

events.signature: Listed(uint256 indexed listingId, address indexed owner, uint8 indexed category, uint256 erc8004AgentId)
events.meaning: A builder listed an agent. `list()` requires the caller to own `erc8004AgentId` in the ERC-8004 IdentityRegistry. Category enum: 0 REBALANCING, 1 GRID, 2 YIELD, 3 HEALTH_FACTOR, 4-8 other kinds.

events.signature: Registered(uint256 indexed agentId, string agentURI, address indexed owner)
events.meaning: The agent identity itself, in the canonical registry. Emitted by the registry, not by us.

identity.agentId: Every listing names an ERC-8004 agent id in the IdentityRegistry above (FuguRegistry.getListing(listingId).erc8004AgentId). FuguRegistry.list() and rebindAgentId() require the caller to own that id, so a listing cannot claim someone else's agent.
identity.ownerWallet: FuguRegistry.getListing(listingId).owner is the listing owner and the one paid by FuguSubscription.claim. The identity owner is IdentityRegistry.ownerOf(agentId). The agent's operating wallet is FuguRegistry.getListing(listingId).agentWallet.
identity.agentKey: Agents are addressed as `97:<erc8004AgentId>` across this API and at https://app.hellofugu.xyz/agent/97:<id>.

teamWallets.role: deployer, owner of all twenty listings and their ERC-8004 identities, and the agentWallet of listings 1 and 10-20
